body: The go directive had said 1.26.4, just the installed toolchain. The real floor is range-over-int in parse.go (1.22); nothing in the stdlib newer than 1.20 (errors.Join, strings.CutPrefix) is used. Why: four minor versions is the difference between a service adopting the library without a toolchain upgrade and not. Three benchmarks using b.Loop (1.24) went back to the classic loop. Verified by building and vetting with a real go1.22.0 toolchain, and the full suite passes on 1.23. The cli stays at 1.26.4 because it uses errors.AsType (1.26) and golang.org/x/term floors it at 1.25.
title: Library minimum Go is 1.22; the cli module stays at 1.26.4
